limitations: The model projects a process group to one checker. Independently daemonized process groups are outside this ownership boundary.

The implementation conformance runs all 23 runner checks, including real Node parent/child/grandchild cancellation, inventory receipt retention and source-change rejection. Compiler semantic correctness remains in each source model.
Operating-system process and Job Object semantics are platform assumptions. Linux conformance is exercised in this repository's Quint CI job.

Managed nested cancellation and late child spawn are bounded by a three-second direct-controller grace inside the enclosing ten-second grace. Arbitrary external suspension and uncatchable controller termination remain outside the progress guarantee.
